name: design co-work styles, the mockup gate, and agent-runnable create-phase
objective: Give design co-work three named operator-chosen styles (build-after / design-only / paired), move the single per-round approval onto a runnable mockup built in the project's own frontend language, close the unvalidated --kind hole in the engine, and let the agent invoke create-phase on instruction while the operator-confirmation gate stays put. Ships as workspace v34.

review.note: All four slices validated together: workflow validate, retrofit smoke (123 PASS / 0 FAIL, Tests 0-8), build.py --check, sync-agents --check, the executor-agent diff, and the --kind behaviour exercised by hand in a throwaway workspace. The central claim holds -- the Never block went 14 bullets to 15 with none deleted, four narrowed, one added, one scope-qualified; the only scope that shrank is the functional sweep, onto the stubbed-mockup case, while the manifest-runtime rule got stronger. Docs consolidated into operations v0028, decisions v0036, qa v0004. Three deferred jobs filed (D5-D7), including one non-blocking finding: review-phase gate stage 4 lacks the mockup qualifier stage 3 received.

acceptance.note: Workspace machinery only: rewrites the design-cowork skill, the contract, both drivers, both executor agents, and the engine's --kind validation. No operator-visible product surface changes; the mockup gate this phase specifies is exercised by phases that adopt it, not by this one.
